clauses.evidence: E03-S13#AC1/#AC3 (confirms the 300 ms clause); E04-S05#DoD1 tag adds nothing, see finding
E04-S02#AC1, #AC2 (threshold boundary at exactly 10 big bets not asserted, see LOW finding)

findings.evidence: DoD1 'at Rapid ... 200 hands complete in under 60 minutes' is tagged REQ-011.1 ('each bot action displayed within 300 ms of the previous action'). The 200-hands/60-min check would still pass if the 300 ms gap were not implemented (18 s per hand budget), so the tag confirms nothing. REQ-011.1 is genuinely covered by E03-S13#AC1/#AC3, so coverage is not lost, but the RTM overstates it.
findings.fix: Remove REQ-011.1 from E04-S05#DoD1 (tag REQ-024 fit criterion or nothing), or change the DoD to assert the median bot-action gap is still <= 300 ms with animations on.

findings.evidence: ACs test 'the theme's green felt colour', 'a code-drawn texture', 'the theme's dark rail colour' and 'theme's red, navy or silver tokens'; no concrete values or thresholds are given and AC names implementation tokens. 'Subtle texture' (REQ-067.1) is only checkable by an approved snapshot that does not yet exist.
findings.fix: State measurable values (e.g. felt hue range / hex, rail luminance lower than felt by a stated ratio, chip palette hex list) or make the approved snapshot a named deliverable of the story; phrase ACs on observed colours not 'theme tokens'.

findings.evidence: AC6 (no hidden card in log) is tagged REQ-023.1; the clause (player, action, amount) would not fail if a hole card leaked. It is a valid no-leak check but belongs to REQ-025.
findings.fix: Drop REQ-023.1 tag from AC6 or retag to REQ-025 intent.

findings.evidence: REQ-071.1 trigger is 'pot of 10 big bets or more'. AC2 tests 9 big bets ($72, no bubble) but no AC asserts the exact boundary of 10 big bets ($80) does trigger eligibility.
findings.fix: Add AC: Given a bot wins an uncontested $80 pot at $4/$8 and is not rate-limited, When the hand ends, Then that bot is eligible to show a bubble [REQ-071.1].

findings.evidence: Trigger 'a new player sitting down' does not say which bot speaks (the newcomer, or any/all existing bots); E04-S02 cannot state who speaks without a decision.
findings.fix: Decide: the new bot greets, or one existing bot reacts; then add AC.

summary: All 27 clauses covered; table art ACs lack exact values; one mis-tagged DoD item.
